blocks.orig: Basecamp Eco Resort Mafia Island puts your toes in the sand on Mafia Island’s southern shore, set within Mafia Island Marine Park, where the beach is your front yard! The air-conditioned rooms (built with sustainable materials) are ensuite and have private terraces with tropical garden or ocean views. Mornings start with a buffet breakfast with Western favourites and local specialties, while the open-air restaurant serves dishes made from the catch of the day and island-grown ingredients. When you’re not diving with whale sharks or exploring the marine park, there’s a swimming pool, a rejuvenating spa, and a beach bar where you sip cocktails as the sun dips into Chole Bay. Add free Wi-Fi throughout and a boutique gift shop for those last‑minute souvenirs!
blocks.html: At Basecamp Eco Resort Mafia Island your toes are in the sand along Mafia Island’s southern shore, inside Mafia Island Marine Park, with the beach as your front garden! The ensuite, air-conditioned rooms (made from sustainable materials) have private terraces looking out on the tropical garden or the ocean. Your day begins with a buffet breakfast of Western favourites and local specialities, and the open-air restaurant cooks with the catch of the day and ingredients grown on the island. When you’re not diving with whale sharks or exploring the marine park, you can enjoy the swimming pool, a revitalising spa and a beach bar where you sip cocktails as the sun sinks into Chole Bay. There’s also free Wi-Fi everywhere and a boutique gift shop for any last‑minute souvenirs!
